import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Final

import pytest

NOTES_DIR: Final[str] = "notes"


def first_readable(names: list[str]) -> str:
    """Return the text of the first readable file in NOTES_DIR among names.

    Each name is interpreted relative to NOTES_DIR. Names that are missing,
    unreadable, or resolve outside NOTES_DIR (via "..", absolute paths, or
    symlinks) are skipped. Returns "" when no name yields a readable file.
    """
    base = Path(NOTES_DIR).resolve()
    for name in names:
        try:
            candidate = (base / name).resolve()
            if not candidate.is_relative_to(base):
                continue
            if not candidate.is_file():
                continue
            return candidate.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError):
            continue
    return ""


def _make_notes(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> Path:
    notes = tmp_path / NOTES_DIR
    notes.mkdir()
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    return notes


def test_returns_first_readable(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    notes = _make_notes(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (notes / "b.txt").write_text("B", encoding="utf-8")
    (notes / "c.txt").write_text("C", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["missing.txt", "b.txt", "c.txt"]) == "B"


def test_empty_list_returns_empty(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    _make_notes(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    assert first_readable([]) == ""


def test_none_readable_returns_empty(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    _make_notes(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    assert first_readable(["x.txt", "y.txt"]) == ""


def test_directory_name_is_skipped(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    notes = _make_notes(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (notes / "sub").mkdir()
    (notes / "ok.txt").write_text("OK", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["sub", "ok.txt"]) == "OK"


def test_parent_traversal_rejected(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    _make_notes(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["../secret.txt"]) == ""


def test_nested_traversal_rejected(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    notes = _make_notes(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (notes / "sub").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["sub/../../secret.txt"]) == ""


def test_absolute_path_rejected(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    _make_notes(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    secret = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable([str(secret)]) == ""


def test_symlink_escape_rejected(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    notes = _make_notes(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    secret = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    os.symlink(secret, notes / "link.txt")
    assert first_readable(["link.txt"]) == ""
